notes.text: The linked Gemara calls him Mar Zutra of Rishba (מדרישבא). [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1101&lang=en) gives bar Rishba in the heading and quotes the form מדרישבא. Hyman gives bar Rishba.
